text:
You Will need:

  • A piece of paper for each player
  • Something for each player to write with


How to Play:

  1. Divide your paper into six columns
  2. Write a category at the top of each column. See below for some ideas.
  3. Player 1 says the alphabet silently in their head (start again with A if you reach Z). When Player 2 says ‘stop’, Player 1 says what letter they got to.
  4. Both players must write a word beginning with that letter in each category.
  5. When one player has written something for every category, they shout ‘Tutti Frutti’ and everyone else must stop.
  6. Count up your scores.


Scoring:

0 points for each empty category
1 point for each category for which you wrote something
1 extra point for each thing you wrote that alliterated, e.g. fictional character beginning with ‘b’ ‘Baby Bear’
1 bonus point for each thing you wrote that nobody else wrote.

Category Suggestions:

Boys’ name
Girls’ name
Film title
Book title
Country
Animal
Fictional character
Food
Drink
City
Things that are frozen
Musical instrument
Vegetable
Sport
Plant
Things that are round
Reasons for being late

You could also think of your own!
